basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old musician from Portland, Oregon, specializing in playing the bass guitar. Music has always been my passion, and I spend a lot of my time jamming with my band and exploring new music genres. When I'm not playing music, I'm often researching stocks, especially in the electric vehicle sector, with a keen interest in NIO. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it provides to pursue my interests. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-11 PM PST. Besides music and stocks, I'm also a collector of vintage Nintendo games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Music Production and have been playing the bass for over 10 years. My interest in stocks, particularly in the tech and EV sectors, is mostly self-taught, driven by online courses and active participation in investment forums.
